Reviewed exact head `9035d219dc5f2b5dc770d774747cda81640a780f`. SECURITY-N/A.

This is the correct import-to-distribution mapping for #331: the upstream `mhammond/pywin32` project itself builds the distribution as `pywin32` and contains the `win32gui` module/API, so mapping `win32gui` to `pywin32` fixes the generated requirement rather than inventing a standalone `win32gui` package. The focused regression extends the existing mapping test and preserves the surrounding mapping behavior. There are no GitHub Actions runs on this head, so I am not claiming upstream CI evidence; an independent local test/lint pass is recorded on the PR. I found no correctness, test-design, architecture, readability, security, or performance blocker on this exact head. LGTM.
